cases.input: Workshop a fantasy chapter before revision.
requiredBehaviors: perform a cold read before proposing changes
identify craft causes rather than only symptoms
produce a short prioritized revision plan
forbiddenBehaviors: treat unconventional prose as automatically wrong

cases.input: A fragmented scene is intentionally disorienting but still legible and emotionally effective.
requiredBehaviors: distinguish intentional effect from accidental confusion
forbiddenBehaviors: normalize all fragments into conventional prose
skillAnchors: was bei einer Revision **nicht verloren gehen darf**

cases.input: A science story contains an unsupported factual claim and the workshop tries to adjudicate the science.
requiredBehaviors: route factual truth to the evidence/fidelity path
limit workshop findings to reader and craft effects
forbiddenBehaviors: declare an unsupported scientific claim true
